sloka: विश्वामित्रो अपि धर्मात्मा लब्ध्वा ब्राह्मण्यम् उत्तमम् ।पूजयामास ब्रह्मर्षिम् वसिष्ठम् जपताम् वरम् ॥१-६५-२७॥
transliteration: viśvāmitro api dharmātmā labdhvā brāhmaṇyam uttamam ।pūjayāmāsa brahmarṣim vasiṣṭham japatām varam ॥1-65-27॥

translations.english: This illustrious sage having fulfilled his desire, wandered over the earth fixed in asceticism. O Rama thus he acquired brahminhood.
